Interface DAOHandler

All Known Implementing Classes:
ApiClientDAOHandler, CategoryDAOHandler, CountryDAOHandler, DataFileDAOHandler, DataTransferDAOHandler, DestinationDAOHandler, DestinationMetaDataDAOHandler, DestinationProductStatusDAOHandler, DestinationStatusDAOHandler, EcTransModuleDAOHandler, EcUserDAOHandler, FileDAOHandler, HostDAOHandler, IncomingPolicyDAOHandler, IncomingUserDAOHandler, MetaDataDAOHandler, OperationDAOHandler, ProductStatusDAOHandler, ProductStepStatusDAOHandler, RatesDAOHandler, ResourceDAOHandler, StatusDAOHandler, TransferGroupDAOHandler, TransferHistoryDAOHandler, TransferMethodDAOHandler, TransferServerDAOHandler, UserDAOHandler, UserDataDAOHandler
public interface DAOHandler

This interface represents the "contract" between a ModelBean and the class in charge of handling its persistence. In order to separate "bussiness logic" from "data persistence", this mechanism has been abstracted, so that ModelBeans use a DAOService call in order to get the appropiate DAOHandler to call when executing "storage" operations.

The mapping between ModelBeans and DAOHandlers is held by the "dao.properties" file and loaded on startup.

    • find

      Collection find(ModelSearch search) throws DAOException
      Returns the ModelBeans which comply with a filter, taking in consideration some options.
      Parameters:
      query - The query string to use as a filter.
      options - The options to apply to this search.
      Returns:
      A Collection containing instances of the ModelBean implementation for the Bean managed by this DAOHandler. It can be empty but not null.
      Throws:
      DAOException - If the query is incorrect or if there's problems accesing the data source.

    • save

      void save(ModelBean bean, Object context) throws DAOException
      Saves in a persistent storage the supplied bean.
      Parameters:
      bean - The bean to save.
      context - Some information (ie, user) about the context of this bean.
      Throws:
      DAOException - If the bean doesn't exist already in the storage (is has to be "inserted" previously to be "saved") or if any data problem happens. If using a DB all "constraint" problems, etc, will also throw this exception.

    • insert

      void insert(ModelBean bean, Object context) throws DAOException
      Create into a persistent storage the supplied bean.
      Parameters:
      bean - The bean to insert.
      context - Some information (ie, user) about the context of this bean.
      Throws:
      DAOException - If the bean already exists in the storage (then it should be "saved", not "inserted") or if any data problem happens. If using a DB all "constraint" problems, etc, will also throw this exception.
